# Golden Skyrim workflow resumption fixture

The Task 7 selector creates all executable fixture bytes beneath one unique
`K:\Actorwright\artifacts\test-work` lab. It reuses the checked-in closed
protocol-v2 probe bytes and never checks in a mod project.

The transcript has two intentionally disconnected segments:

1. reviewed workspace intake -> preset inspection -> NPC build preflight ->
   actual static NPC package -> authentic off-engine preview;
2. seeded Finish manifest -> Finish verification -> runtime-acceptance gate.

Before the first segment runs, the selector derives its owned request from the
reviewed `blank-npc-v1` product FaceGeom and FaceTint fixtures. It admits exact
Blender 4.5.1, PyNifly-profile, and Texconv authorities copied into the owned
lab, then independently reopens the package, preview bundle, hash manifest,
six views and masks, contact sheet, renderer status, and resumed workflow. A
fresh copy of the validated contact sheet is retained under ignored
`artifacts/static-npc-build-preview` for agent and user inspection.

Each continuing command runs in a fresh process after the prior fixture-local
operation journal is removed. Resumption authority comes only from explicit
artifact paths and uppercase SHA-256 bindings. Byte-for-byte copies moved to a
different root are refused because the artifacts bind the original exact lab;
the second root must rerun Workspace Preflight.

This fixture proves static, same-root, process-independent build and preview
resumption only. It does not establish game-runtime verification,
human-visual acceptance, or promotion approval. It executes no AI Package,
location, Finish Apply, Desktop, or game process.
